bio: I'm a Product Designer who turns user insights into product strategy, information architecture, and high-fidelity design with a background in graphic and event experience design that shapes how I think about hierarchy, storytelling, and brand identity.

My work spans both digital and physical experiences. For one client, I improved website comprehension from a baseline understanding to 60% clarity through research-led redesign; for another, I reduced cognitive load and increased task speed by 30% by simplifying flows and removing friction. I also led the transformation of a legacy POS system for two restaurants moving from a slow, opaque, hard-to-learn system to one that cuts checkout time by 50%, reduces order errors, and gives owners real-time sales visibility, all while making menu edits fast enough that no one needs to visit in person anymore.

I use personas, journey maps, service blueprints, decision matrices, and fishbone analysis to surface friction and prioritize what actually moves the needle. Depending on the project, I've worked as a solo lead, a founder, and a cross-functional partner alongside product, engineering, and marketing teams because good design rarely happens alone, but it always starts with understanding people.
community: Designed and led inclusive beginner design workshops to help 50+ young people from diverse backgrounds build confidence and access creative opportunities. Volunteer with Get REAL Movement, supporting LGBTQ+ education and inclusive community events across Canada.
